d: Prakash Raj essays the role of Vengadam the best silk weaver in the small town of Kanchivaram in Tamil nadu. He pledges that he would give his daughter a silk saree on her marriage. His pledge becomes the talk of the town as it was impossible for a weaver to afford an expensive saree like Kanchivaram in the pre independence era. Vegandam saves money for the purpose but his brother-in-law ruins his plans. Then to keep his promise Vegandam starts stealing silk strands from his work place. At the same time he also leads a strike to demand a pay hike for weavers. Will Vegandam be able to…
